SUMMARYBackend Engineer with 3 years delivering high-scale fintech infrastructure in Go and PHP — identity, risk, and notification systems processing 1M+ daily requests. Hands-on with LLM/RAG pipelines, MCP protocol, and AI-driven automation in production. Targeting SDE2 / AI Engineer roles at product-led companies.EXPERIENCESDE-1 · Niyo Solutions Inc.May 2025 – Present▸Architected unified Identity & Onboarding backbone (Video KYC, CKYC, in-house DKYC) — sole RBI-compliant entry point across all Niyo verticals.▸Built Real-Time Risk Profiling Engine — AML scores, PEP status, and income-bracket classification at onboarding with zero added user friction.▸Pioneered AI/MCP initiative: prototyped MCP auth patterns + shipped AI-driven Regional Manager workflows, cutting manual ops intervention by ~40%.▸Architected company-wide Intelligence Vault on S3 with Karza + in-house OCR — turned passive document storage into a live data-extraction utility.Software Engineer · Open Financial TechnologiesJul 2023 – May 2025▸Migrated notification service from PHP to Go — goroutine concurrency reduced instance count and p99 latency by ~30% while scaling to 1M+ daily hits.▸Designed end-to-end backend for HDFC Bank-MBDB payout and beneficiary platform — high availability across thousands of SME merchants, zero critical post-launch incidents.▸Shipped platform-wide priority queue mechanism, reducing failed-job retry rate and standardising async processing across all services.▸Embedded ELK APIs into admin portal — reduced mean time to debug production incidents by 60%, eliminating blind log-hunting during outages.▸Achieved 100% uptime across 3 high-risk DB migrations via phased rollouts, table reversals, and automated data integrity checks.Software Engineer Intern · Open Financial TechnologiesJan – Jun 2023▸Built and shipped microservice for AXIS Bank Neo-Banking platform enabling invoice generation — delivered in 6 weeks, adopted in production at scale.PROJECTSAgentic Equity Trading Bot

Go 1.24 · Groq/Llama-3.3-70B · INDstocks API · Docker (distroless) · WebSocket▸Built a fully autonomous NSE/BSE trading agent — LLM function-calling loop dispatches 8 broker tools (quotes, orders, portfolio, funds) with zero human intervention during market hours.▸Engineered real-time price feeds via WebSocket with exponential backoff reconnect; market hours guard (09:15–15:30 IST) and --once flag for dry runs.▸Enforced in-agent risk controls: ₹10,000 max order size, ₹2,000 daily loss cap, max 5 open positions — safety layer baked into the LLM decision loop.▸Shipped at zero infra cost — Groq free tier (14,400 req/day); distroless Docker image with ~8 MB runtime and no shell attack surface.SKILLSLanguages: Go · PHP · Python · C++Architecture: Microservices · gRPC · REST · Event-Driven · MCP Protocol · Low-Level DesignCloud & Infra: AWS (Lambda · SQS · S3 · EventBridge · SNS) · Kubernetes · Docker · Kafka · RabbitMQ · RedisAI / LLM: LangChain · RAG Pipelines · Prompt Engineering · OpenAI APIs · Groq · Hugging Face · VectorDBObservability: Grafana · Kibana · Datadog · GroundCover · DevtronEDUCATIONB.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering2019 – 2023Lovely Professional University · CGPA: 8.23 / 10 SHREYANSH TIWARIBackend Engineer · Distributed Systems · AI/LLM IntegrationBengaluru · +91-9907408787 · shreyansh.tiwari8@gmail.com
